verdicts.reason: Both are the original squeezed into a leaderboard rather than redesigned for it. The three-line headline stays stacked in a small centred purple box, when this banner shape calls for a single horizontal line. The type is tiny at this size and leaves big areas of busy, blurry photo on either side, and the crop loses the furniture scene that gave the original its meaning. In A, the purple box runs nearly edge to edge vertically, so the text feels jammed against the top and bottom. B leaves a little more breathing room around the box, so it is marginally better, but the two are essentially the same failed resize.
